text: Lunch with Lucía. I told her that sometimes I feel like I only exist, that I go from delivery to delivery without living anything. She asked me when was the last time I felt alive, and I told her it was in Montserrat. She said that then I already know what I need.
points: I feel like I only exist and don't live.
The last time I felt alive was in Montserrat.
